summary: Traws Pharma, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a new prospectus supplement to its existing At The Market Offering Agreement with Citizens JMP Securities. The supplement allows the company to sell up to $3.13M of common shares under its current baby shelf limitation, down from the original $50M ATM facility. The shares are sold through Citizens as agent under an effective S-3 shelf. This is a routine financing update, not a special situation. No terms like price or premium are stated. No activist, M&A, or restructuring element. The filing is a procedural update to an existing equity distribution program.
